name: agent-grok-consult
description: Consult Grok or search X with official Grok CLI first, quota-gated anonymous fallback, and authorization-gated authenticated fallback.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Grok or search X with a bounded fallback chain.
interface.longDescription: Keep GPT in control while using the official Grok CLI for consultation and native X search, with anonymous FxTwitter fallback only after explicit account-quota exhaustion and authenticated OpenCLI/xreach fallback only after current-task authorization.
defaultPrompt: Ask Grok for an independent second opinion.
Search public X posts with Grok and verify their publication times.
Find X posts from a fixed date and exclude out-of-window results.
